posts.name: lynkfox
posts.cooked:
I get bored and just drift through the Comments section. Some people leave full game debrief's, others have random HP totals and such. And some have random comments like the following - thought Id share...

 

You're full of crap--Apostate is not an easy villain without the best of the best of the best.

Bunker's first 9 cards contained 7 mode cards!

Ow

Dreamer on 1HP and AZ used his incap power to kill her, huzzah for heroes! 

oh god why oh god why - Return with the Dawn + Anvil + Truth + Summer + Autumn for the opening turn ... dear god for 10 rounds at least we just killed Truth over ... and over... and over... and over...

Typical Ambuscade trouncing.  A trap actually triggered though!

Plague Rat ended the game on -20HP, thanks to Fixed Point.

Legacy was a jerk again

Freedom Six vs Iron Legacy... pretty epic, well-played, design team.

Oh my god.

Krakens everywhere.

Step 1: Write a guide on beating the Advanced Ennead. Step 2: Lose to the Advanced Ennead. Step 3: ?????
